name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: A quick and easy fried rice with tender chicken, vegetables, and egg.
instructions: Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add diced chicken and cook until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add onion, carrots, and garlic. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Push vegetables to the side and pour beaten eggs into the pan.
Scramble the eggs until just set, then mix with vegetables.
Add cooked rice and frozen peas. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
description: Rich and creamy pasta with a tomato-based sauce, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, sauté until soft, about 3-4 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in heavy cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
Drain pasta and add to sauce, toss to coat.
Serve with fresh basil and extra pepper.

name: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Traditional Italian pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a pizza stone or baking sheet inside.
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface to desired thickness.
Mix tomato sauce with garlic, salt, and sugar.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a border.
Tear fresh mozzarella and distribute over the sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
Top with fresh basil leaves and serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry with Tofu
description: A healthy vegetarian stir-fry loaded with colorful vegetables and crispy tofu.
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water, then cube.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Add tofu and fry until golden on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, carrot, and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes.
Return tofu to wok and add sauce mixture.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.

name: Classic French Omelette
description: A simple yet elegant French omelette with a soft, creamy center.
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl and beat with salt, pepper, and cream if using.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until foamy.
Pour in beaten eggs and immediately start stirring with a spatula.
As eggs begin to set, stop stirring and let them form a skin on the bottom.
When eggs are mostly set but still slightly runny on top, fold the omelette in half.
Slide onto plate and sprinkle with fresh chives.
Serve immediately.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Flavorful Mexican beef tacos with fresh toppings.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft, about 3-4 minutes.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Fill each shell with beef mixture.
Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, avocado, and sour cream.
Serve immediately with your favorite hot sauce.

name: Vegetable Curry with Coconut Milk
description: A creamy and aromatic vegetable curry with coconut milk and Indian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and stir for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add potatoes, carrots, and cauliflower. Stir to coat with spices.
Pour in coconut milk and 1/2 cup water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add green peas and cook for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over rice.

name: Caesar Salad with Grilled Chicken
description: Classic Caesar salad topped with juicy grilled chicken breast.
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Wash and chop romaine lettuce.
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Top with sliced chicken, croutons, and parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Italian risotto with mushrooms and parmesan cheese.
instructions: Heat vegetable stock in a pot and keep warm.
In a large pan, heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and mushrooms, cook until mushrooms release their water.
Add arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes to toast.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
Continue adding stock until rice is creamy and al dente, about 20 minutes.
Stir in remaining butter and parmesan cheese.
Season with fresh thyme, salt, and pepper.

name: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with mashed banana in the batter, perfect for breakfast.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, melted butter, and mashed bananas.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake onto the pan.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Vegetables
description: Simple egg fried rice with mixed vegetables - perfect for using leftover rice.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables and cook for 3 minutes.
Push vegetables to the side and crack eggs into the pan.
Scramble eggs until just set, then mix with vegetables.
Add rice and soy sauce, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with spring onions and serve.

name: Spicy Thai Chicken Curry
description: Aromatic Thai red curry with chicken, coconut milk, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large pot over medium heat.
Add curry paste and stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add half the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes.
Add remaining coconut milk, bamboo shoots, and bell pepper.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer for 10 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add lime leaves and Thai basil just before serving.
Serve with jasmine rice.

name: Shakshuka
description: Middle Eastern dish of eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook for 5-7 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack eggs into each.
Cover and cook for 5-8 minutes until eggs are set.
Garnish with cilantro.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting chicken noodle soup with vegetables - perfect when you're feeling under the weather.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, thyme, and bay leaves. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add chicken breasts and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred with forks, and return to pot.
Add noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

name: Greek Salad
description: Fresh and healthy Greek salad with feta cheese and olives.
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, bell pepper, and olives in a large bowl.
Add feta cheese cubes.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Serve immediately as a side dish or light meal.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Succulent shrimp in a rich garlic butter sauce - ready in 15 minutes.
instructions: Season shrimp with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp in a single layer, cook for 2 minutes.
Flip shrimp and add white wine and lemon juice.
Cook for 2-3 more minutes until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve hot with crusty bread for dipping.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Classic chewy chocolate chip cookies with a soft center.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cream together butter, sugar, and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla.
In separate bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop by rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets.
Bake for 9-11 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on wire racks.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Simple Italian salad with tomatoes, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
instructions: Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately as an appetizer.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Classic Chinese-inspired beef and broccoli in a savory sauce.
instructions: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch, and water.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat.
Add beef and stir-fry until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to wok.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return beef to wok and add sauce.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Creamy avocado on toasted sourdough topped with perfectly poached eggs.
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until golden and crispy.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Bring water to a gentle simmer in a pot, add vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small bowl.
Create a whirlpool in the water and slide in eggs.
Poach for 3-4 minutes for runny yolks.
Spread mashed avocado on toast.
Top with poached eggs.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and additional salt.
Add cherry tomatoes if desired and serve immediately.
